actions.body:
Intelligent systems operating within fixed cognitive architectures encounter structural limitations when monitoring their own reasoning processes. As shown in metareasoning literature, detecting blind spots requires evaluating epistemic authority and deference dynamics.

Summary: Cognitive architectures face boundary constraints that necessitate structured metareasoning.
actions.lede: An evaluation of cognitive architecture limits and metareasoning error detection.
